crossRefs.note: You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth:
Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.
Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious…
Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk…
The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he,

translations.web: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.
translations.bsb: But let justice roll on like a river, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
translations.kjv: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
translations.asv: But let justice roll down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
